geometryPolicy: 48 CSS pixel minimum action targets; project adaptations and unsupported variants documented in README

changes.description: A link card shows one hover layer: the anchor inside the card no longer adds the shared link hover and glint on top of the card state layer.

Nested surfaces share one radius rule: an inner surface takes the container radius minus the padding the container applies, with a 2px floor. Dialogs, sheets and cards publish the value as `--bb-inset-radius` and a card placed inside them inherits it; the card tail is clamped to the card radius. Menu items, autocomplete and search suggestions derive their corners from the container radius, and docked date picker and time picker fields derive theirs from the calendar or dialog padding.

Built-in messages in French and Simplified Chinese besides English and Italian, chosen from the language subtag (`supportedLocale`); tab scroll buttons and the rich tooltip dismiss button are now localized instead of fixed English.

Tooltips wider than their trigger align their tail corner over the trigger centre (start-aligned, end-aligned near the right edge) instead of centring, and the tail side is computed from the final position rather than from the box scaled by the entry animation.
Slider `compact` attribute for the bubble variant: a 32px row with the value beside the label; the value bubble appears only while dragging or with keyboard focus.

Card `tail` property (`bottom-start` default, `bottom-end`, `top-start`, `top-end`) so the narrow corner points at where the card comes from. Link cards (`href`) make the whole surface the target, with a hover state layer, a raised float on elevated cards and a focus ring.

Scrollbars inside components have no arrow buttons and round track and thumb ends, inset from the container edges (`--bb-scrollbar-*`). Tabs with a fixed height keep the tab row in place and scroll only the panel.
List rows render the trailing count badge declared by the item `badge`, on the top-level rows and on the nested ones, with the badge tokens already used by tabs and the drawer.

Search bar geometry: the field wrapper grows with the bar, the input fills it, the label and supporting text stay only in the accessibility tree and the focus indicator is drawn on the bar instead of a smaller box inside it.
Connected button group inner corners follow the M3 per-size values (XS 4dp, S/M 8dp, L 16dp, XL 20dp) with the hovered growth specified for each size, instead of reusing the shape scale.
Select and autocomplete components over native options; per-component spacing tokens with Material names for navigation rail, list, carousel and search bar; field height and vertical padding tokens.
35 component entries, public types, shared action/form/surface tokens and catalogue examples; existing menu and generated typography retained.
